history.summary: Compact 506sqft 1BR at Stars of Kovan, a 2020 mixed-use development literally on top of Kovan NEL MRT (350m), $900K at $1,778 PSF — ~8% below the $1,933 URA median. Excellent transit-integrated location, but a low Elo (1382) and tepid 2.8%/yr appreciation make it a steady-yield play rather than a growth one.
history.rating_rationale: 350m to Kovan MRT plus integrated retail is a genuine rental-magnet location, and $900K is firmly in the liquid entry band with below-median PSF. But the URA appreciation is only 2.81%/yr (110 txns, reliable but low — below OCR baseline), the arena Elo is the lowest in the batch (1382), and 1BR is a niche resale unit. This is a defensible income/yield hold near an MRT, not a capital-growth pick.
red_flags: Low 2.81%/yr appreciation on 110 txns — below OCR baseline
1BR niche resale; mixed-use can carry higher maintenance/noise
catalysts: 350m to Kovan NEL MRT, integrated retail — strong rental pull

history.summary: Genuinely under-priced 1BR in a mixed development 2-3 min from Kovan MRT (NEL), in the strongest forward region (D19/OCR). Web comps confirm the asking PSF is well below recent resale levels — the rare case where the algo's 'cheap' is real.
history.rating_rationale: Asking 1,778.66 PSF vs verified 12-month resale range 1,650-2,042 (avg ~1,920; 6-month ~1,875). The ask is ~7% below the trailing average and near the bottom of the range — a real discount that corroborates the -2.9% age-adj and -3.0% vs-cohort signals. Direct 2-3 min walk to Kovan MRT and integrated retail underpins strong, durable rental demand (~3.4% historical yield). D19/OCR is the best-realized forward region in the v3.4 backtest. Confidence held at medium because the 1BR cohort is thin (psf_cohort_txns 5), so the exact discount magnitude carries noise.
red_flags: Thin 1BR size-cohort (psf_cohort_txns 5) — discount magnitude has measurement noise
Small 506 sqft unit is investor-grade, more cyclical exit liquidity than larger formats
catalysts: 2-3 min walk to Kovan MRT (NEL), one stop from Serangoon interchange
Integrated mixed development (retail at doorstep) supports rental demand
